plugins.none: No plugins of your own yet
plugins.none.description: Cast one above, or install one a colleague sent you.
plugins.builtin.description: What wisp is made of. Switching one off frees everything it made; what needs it says why
plugins.trusted: Trusted: it runs as its own process with your environment, and its styles apply.
plugins.untrusted: Untrusted: it runs fenced in, and its styles don’t apply until you trust it.
plugins.asksNothing: It asks for nothing beyond showing itself.
plugins.trustAsk.title: Trust {name}?
plugins.trustAsk.detail: {name} then runs as its own process with your environment: it can read and change your files, use your keys and reach the network, and its styles apply. Trust only a plugin you know.
plugins.removeAsk.title: Remove {name}?
plugins.removeAsk.detail: Turns it off and deletes it. Whatever it changed goes back to how wisp was. Its source folder stays where it is.
plugins.cast.hint: Ask for a change to wisp. An agent writes it as a plugin; you switch it on and keep it.
plugins.cast.placeholder: A floating button that opens all my PRs…
plugins.cast.pin: Writes a plugin, not your code
plugins.foot.post: . Turning one off puts back exactly what it changed.
plugins.slash.hint: Make a wisp plugin: an agent writes it, you switch it on
